items.name: Crono
items.title: Le pas qui défie le temps
items.scene: Crono from Chrono Trigger, recognizable vivid spiky red hair, white headband with loose tails, blue-teal sleeveless travelling tunic, orange scarf, brown belt, pale practical trousers, scuffed brown boots and leather wrist protection. Brave young swordsman, alert determined eyes, a trace of fear overcome by resolve. Three-quarter view advancing down a broad rain-dark stone step, left knee flexed naturally and back foot planted. He holds a long katana in both hands in a low diagonal ready guard; continuous coherent two-handed grip, straight extended blade, calm readable length rather than distorted perspective. Scarf lifts in the wind. A few fine blue-white sparks run close along the steel, not a giant lightning explosion. Background: one simple ruined stone gateway fading into a broad storm-grey sky; no city. Warm late sunlight breaks through on his face and orange scarf, opposed to cool rain. Full-body framing, face not hidden by hair, strong natural silhouette and upright torso.
items.alt: Crono avance sur des marches humides, son katana parcouru de fines étincelles.

items.name: Marle
items.title: Le courage derrière le sourire
items.scene: Marle from Chrono Trigger, recognizable golden blond high ponytail, lively blue eyes, white sleeveless high-neck travelling outfit with loose white trousers, orange-gold belt, brown practical boots, turquoise jewel pendant clearly worn at her neck. Youthful energetic princess, athletic and naturally proportioned, fully clothed nonsexual adventure scene. Three-quarter side stance, one foot braced on a low root, holding her wooden-and-steel CROSSBOW horizontally in both hands at chest height toward an unseen threat outside the image. Stock tucked correctly against shoulder, supporting hand underneath fore-end clear of bowstring and bolt; a real plausible crossbow with straight stock. Face in three-quarter view readable above the stock, expression courageous with concern for someone she protects, not an empty fashion smile. Restrained icy blue condensation glints around the bow limb, not huge spell circles. A quiet snowy forest clearing: one dark trunk, broad blue mist and a soft patch of warm sun. Fine white cloth, muted copper-orange belt, golden hair, clear icy cyan accents. Keep full figure and boots visible with ample lateral space.
items.alt: Marle tient son arbalète en garde dans une clairière froide, le visage attentif.

items.name: Lucca
items.title: Il reste une étincelle
items.scene: Lucca from Chrono Trigger, recognizable short purple hair, large round eyeglasses with visible intelligent eyes, yellow/bronze rounded inventor helmet with ear guards, orange scarf, short green work tunic over a dark undershirt and practical purple leggings, leather belt and worn boots. Small believable sidearm securely HOLSTERED at her hip, not floating. A focused young inventor kneels on one knee beside a waist-low broken machine. Three-quarter seated/kneeling silhouette completely visible; she holds a small screwdriver in her right hand, its tip firmly touching one accessible screw, and steadies a single palm-sized copper power module in her left. Exactly two clearly separated hands, no tangles of wires. Her expression changes from worry into the beginning of a relieved smile as a tiny amber spark lights the module and her glasses. Background just a broad abandoned industrial wall and one open doorway admitting desaturated blue daylight. Few purposeful pieces, no elaborate laboratory clutter. Green cloth, violet hair and tights, orange scarf, warm brass, cold turquoise shadows. Painted textile folds and worn metal, intimate humane moment, not a glamorous portrait.
items.alt: Lucca rallume un petit module, agenouillée près d’une machine abandonnée.

items.name: Frog
items.title: Le poids du serment
items.scene: Frog / Glenn from Chrono Trigger, instantly recognizable green anthropomorphic frog knight: broad amphibian face and visible amber eyes, dignified sorrowful expression, natural expressive brow, stout compact athletic HUMANOID body, one head, two arms and two legs, webbed hands and feet. Not an ordinary frog head pasted on a tall human body. Worn cream tunic, muted gold breastplate, white trousers, blue leather gloves and boots shaped for amphibian feet, green heavy cape. On a quiet mossy stone threshold at dawn, he has just drawn the Masamune and pauses with the great straight silver blade pointing obliquely down beside him, one webbed hand gripping its hilt convincingly, the other hand resting against his chest in a private vow. Distinctive broad double-edged blade with restrained ornate gold guard, hilt and blade on one rigid axis. Upper torso turned three-quarter, head raised toward an absent friend; noble grief and courage. Background only one large worn stone arch and soft wetland mist, no ruined-city clutter. Emerald skin and cape, ivory cloth, old gold, cool turquoise water reflection, warm sunrise edge. Full body, generous breathing space, sword may extend past lower edge rather than bend.
items.alt: Frog fait une pause au seuil d’une arche, la Masamune abaissée et une main sur le cœur.

items.name: Robo
items.title: Ce que ses mains peuvent sauver
items.scene: Robo / R-66Y from Chrono Trigger, recognizable friendly bulky rounded bronze-gold humanoid robot, small barrel-shaped head with two luminous blue eye lenses and a plain lower face grille, broad cylindrical torso, turquoise oxidized joints, thick rounded shoulders, articulated chunky hands and huge stable feet. No human face or organic skin, no reinventing him as a slim android. Near-full body kneeling carefully on one knee in a quiet devastated garden, his massive open palm curved beside a SMALL surviving green seedling without touching or crushing it; other hand braces his weight on the bare soil. The tilt of his head and softly glowing blue eyes convey profound tenderness and curiosity. Natural readable mechanical joints, exactly two arms, believable load bearing, no extra limbs, no detached machinery. Background one broken industrial wall low at the edge and broad pale morning sky, almost empty. Weathered ochre bronze and turquoise patina, a tiny fresh green life focal point, warm morning light outlining the steel. Clearly painterly with tactile chipped paint, broad atmospheric backdrop, not photographic rendering. His silhouette fills the image sensibly and his entire kneeling pose is readable.
items.alt: Robo s’agenouille avec précaution près d’une jeune pousse dans un ancien jardin.

items.name: Ayla
items.title: Personne ne passe derrière elle
items.scene: Ayla from Chrono Trigger, an ADULT primitive-era warrior woman and leader, iconic very long wild blond hair, fierce bright blue eyes, expressive broad grin of fearless challenge, powerful athletic build with strong natural shoulders and legs, not bodybuilder exaggeration. Recognizable practical tawny pale fur fighting top and matching layered hide skirt over fitted leather shorts, fur wrist and ankle wraps, tooth necklace; secure opaque clothing, functional and nonsexual, no glamour pose. No manufactured sword or firearm: she fights with her own fists. Full body caught in a grounded lateral combat guard on an open stone plateau: one foot forward, knees flexed, upper body upright, right fist lifted close to the jaw and left open hand extended only a normal forearm length as she beckons an unseen opponent. Strong correct limb lengths, no crouched perspective tricks. Wind carries her hair diagonally behind rather than obscuring her arms. Emotion: protective ferocity mixed with contagious joy of courage. Background ONLY one broad distant rock ridge below an open clouded sky, no dinosaurs, village or crowded forest. Honey hair and tawny leather balanced by cool desaturated blue-grey rock and selective green vegetation, warm sidelight catches her face. Kalistar painterly grain rather than anime or pin-up.
items.alt: Ayla prend une garde solide sur un plateau dégagé, prête à protéger les siens à mains nues.
